examples.name: Sample — 702
paragraphs: The header declares four price columns ($2,000–$5,000). Rows like Corporal Punishment print one merged note — "Medical Payments Not Available" — spanning all four instead of per-column values, and parent rows such as 612. Owned Watercraft Liability Coverage print no values at all: their four value positions are empty cells. The coverage labels are indented up to three steps.
